actions.body:
Autonomous systems operating in complex environments require robust mechanisms to test and challenge their underlying assumptions. By leveraging metric temporal logic alongside probabilistic scenario generators, cognitive architectures can systematically expose and evaluate epistemic vulnerabilities.

Summary: Integrating formal verification tools helps autonomous agents discover flaws in their foundational decision rules through structured adversarial testing.
